hook: Claude can now review, fix and approve PRs

beats.say: Anthropic launched Claude Ship in beta. It combines Code Review with two new agents, PR Steward and Claude Approvals.
PR Steward fixes failing checks, merge conflicts and review feedback but never merges. Claude Approvals approves routine changes based on a policy file in the repo.
On the Claude Code team, merged pull requests more than doubled from June to September while the share reverted fell by over 40 percent.
